The '''Count of Litwaldov''' was the Ledostrov noble and military commander who defeated the [[Burgrave of Sedava]] during the 1938 crisis.

== Rise ==

Litwaldov commanded the forces that stopped Sedava's march on [[Novoanov]] and defeated the revolt at the [[Battle of Lisebev]]. After Sedava was captured and executed, Litwaldov was crowned duke.

== Reign And Death ==

The source says Litwaldov suppressed several smaller rebellions but reigned only three years before dying of a heart attack in 1942. He died childless, preventing the normal regency rule from operating cleanly.

== Legacy ==

Litwaldov's death created the succession vacuum that allowed [[Uzryta of Ledostrov]] and four allied nobles to impose the [[Pentarchy of Ledostrov]].
